Under Additional settings, conﬁgure the following optional ﬁelds:
• Subject key – You can leave this ﬁeld empty to use the NameID element of the SAML assertion
for the username. If your assertion doesn't use this standard element and instead includes the
username as a custom attribute, specify that attribute here.
• Roles key – If you want to use backend roles (recommended), specify an attribute from the
assertion in this ﬁeld, such as role or group. This is another situation in which tools like SAML-
tracer can help.
• Session time to live – By default, OpenSearch Dashboards logs users out after 24 hours. You can
conﬁgure this value to any number between 60 and 1,440 (24 hours) by specifying a new value.
After you're satisﬁed with your conﬁguration, save the domain.
